name: render_create_custom_domain
description: Add a custom domain to a service (HTTP POST, body {"name": <domain>}). Requires `serviceId` (in the URL) and `name` (the domain to add, e.g. 'app.example.com'). Returns the new custom-domain object with `id`, `domainType` ('apex' or 'subdomain'), and `verificationStatus` ('unverified' at first). IMPORTANT: the response does NOT include the DNS target the user must set — after creating, follow the render-domains skill to derive it (subdomain -> CNAME to the service's serviceDetails.url; apex -> A record to Render's fixed IP 216.24.57.1), then have the user create that record. This attaches a live domain — confirm the exact service and domain first.

serviceId.description: The service id to attach the domain to (e.g. 'srv-...', from render_list_services).

name.description: The custom domain hostname to add, e.g. 'app.example.com' or 'example.com'.
